senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; v. שׁוּק I) [joint,] leg, foreleg, shoulder.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 24a:17">Ber. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>ש׳ באשה ערוה</he> a woman’s bare leg is an indecent sight, i.e. you are not permitted to say your prayers in sight of it.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 10:1">Ḥull. X, 1</cite> <he>חייבין בחזה ובש׳</he> are subject to the law relating to breast and shoulder (<cite ref="Leviticus 7:34">Lev. VII, 34</cite>).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:4">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> <he>שׁוֹקֵיהֶן</he>, v. <cite ref="Q00461"><he>פָּחָז</he></cite>.
